content.short: Vanar is a green, high-speed, low-cost blockchain built for AI, PayFi, and mainstream adoption.
content.description: Vanar is a green, high-speed, low-cost L1 blockchain designed for scalability and broad adoption. Blocks are mined every 3 seconds to support real-time transactions, with minimal fees thanks to a fixed cost structure. The network operates on eco-friendly infrastructure powered by renewable-energy data centers, helping reduce environmental impact. Incubation centers across Asia and Africa support an app ecosystem through developer grants and targeted dApps. Transaction costs remain at 1/20th of a cent, with zero-cost options for brands via account abstraction.
